svg.aria-label: Sleeper — the release gate whose multi-year memory stops slow supply-chain takeovers. Animated: three years of xz-utils events stream into CockroachDB, a prefix-scoped vector search recognizes the takeover arc, and the release is atomically held.
svg.text: Multi-year memory of every commit, email, and handoff —
it sees the slow takeover and holds the release before it ships.
▸ xz 5.6.0 HELD — 34 days before the real-world catch
CockroachDB · VECTOR INDEX · MCP · Bedrock · Lambda

g.text: WHERE package_id='xz-utils' ORDER BY embedding <=> $arc LIMIT 5
